annotations.title: ACA Full-Time and FTE Count (ALE Test)

description: Count full-time employees and full-time equivalents month by month the way the Affordable Care Act employer rules do, and test whether the employer is an applicable large employer (ALE) for the next year. Send the calendar year measured and, for each month, every employee's hours of service as a list of numbers (no names), plus optional extra full-time employees and capped part-time hours for staff you count yourself. Get back per month the full-time count (130 or more hours), the FTEs (non-full-time hours, at most 120 per person, divided by 120) and the total; with all 12 months, the yearly average, the average rounded down, whether it reaches 50, and a flag when 1 to 4 months were above 50 so the seasonal worker exception should be checked. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/aca-fte-count). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.

label.description: Optional label, e.g. 'group A 2026' (your own text, echoed).

months.description: One entry per calendar month (1 to 12 entries, each month once). Send all 12 for the ALE test.

extra_full_time.description: Optional: more full-time employees (130+ hours in the month) not listed in hours.

extra_part_time_hours.description: Optional: total hours of other employees under 130 hours in the month, each already capped at 120, not listed in hours.

hours.description: Hours of service of each employee for the month (up to 200 numbers, up to 2 decimals each, no names). Every employee of the employer and its related companies counts.

items.description: One employee's hours of service in the month.

round_fte_to_hundredth.description: Round each month's FTEs to the nearest hundredth, as 26 CFR 54.4980H-2(c)(2) allows (default false: fractions kept exact).

year.description: The calendar year whose months you send. The ALE answer is for the following year.
